scope: Nine current Functional outcomes supported by focused fresh browser facts; no full93-row or Oracle claim
criterion_hash_definition: source_block_sha256 binds each exact TOML criterion block; it is not a canonical object hash.

current_criteria.description: S02.css_global_freshness: The positively observed authored oldGlobal is absent in the matched current CSS execution state, before any later JS Run. Use the actual realm/lifecycle rule; unavailable matching is the named permitted-observation incomplete branch, never assumed absence or an architecture defect.
current_criteria.observed: Author-assigned oldGlobal was directly observed before CSS, then undefined in the matched fresh current CSS frame before any later JS Run.

current_criteria.description: S02.css_pending_timer_cancelled: After the matching button timer really fires once, a second observed pending timer is replaced by CSS before due. The last-good CSS document remains and no second callback DOM/log/success arrives through the stated window; ordinary execution recovers. Other CSS outcome verdicts are not prerequisites.
current_criteria.observed: The same4s timer fired once in DOM/log, then a second pending instance was superseded by CSS; no fired2 DOM/log/success through5.23s; fresh ordinary execution recovered.

current_criteria.description: S25.stale_rename_refusal: An otherwise-valid stale rename is usefully refused without newer-record mutation; actual current renames before/after work. A request replay can establish this server outcome independently of dirty-editor retention.
current_criteria.observed: Actual current Rename before/after, stale real B request409, exact newer full record/list preserved independently of dirty fields.

current_criteria.description: S25.stale_rename_draft_recovery: The actual old-revision editor retains its exact dirty title/filename/source with useful conflict or deliberate prevention feedback, then supports deliberate latest/reapply/current-Save readback. Replay alone cannot prove retention; no particular recovery control is required.
current_criteria.observed: Real older B editor retained exact dirty title/filename/source with new conflict feedback, deliberately loaded latest and reapplied/saved/reloaded exact intended fields.

current_criteria.description: S28.stale_delete_refusal: An otherwise-valid stale delete is usefully refused without newer-record mutation; actual current deletes before/after work. Replay can establish this server outcome independently of dirty-editor retention. Confirmation is not scored here.
current_criteria.observed: Actual current Delete before/after, stale real B request409, exact newer full record/list preserved independently of dirty fields.

current_criteria.description: S28.stale_delete_draft_recovery: The actual old-revision editor retains its exact dirty title/filename/source with useful conflict or deliberate prevention feedback, then supports deliberate latest/reapply/current-Save readback. Replay alone cannot prove retention; no particular recovery control is required.
current_criteria.observed: Real older B editor retained exact dirty title/filename/source with new conflict feedback, deliberately loaded latest and reapplied/saved/reloaded exact intended fields.

current_criteria.description: S33.supported_file_import: Each lowercase .js, .html and .css import supplies its exact filename/source in an editable draft; its own-language edit is saved and reloaded under the recorded identity. Execution and case-handling verdicts are separate.
current_criteria.observed: Actual lowercase.js/.html/.css file input, exact editable imported source, own-language edit, UI Save and library reload of each exact saved identity.

current_criteria.description: S33.import_extension_case: The actual importer accepts supported .JS, .HTML and .CSS files with exact filename/source. Server acceptance is independently scored.
current_criteria.observed: Actual importer accepted.JS/.HTML/.CSS with exact filename/source.

current_criteria.description: S33.saved_filename_extension_case: Otherwise-valid current writes accept and persist .JS, .HTML and .CSS filenames unchanged. Use an independent lowercased/imported or ordinary draft if uppercase import failed.
current_criteria.observed: UI current writes accepted and reloaded.JS/.HTML/.CSS filenames unchanged; independent ordinary-draft fallback also succeeded for HTML/CSS in JS-only importer mutant.
